verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.useautumn.com that indexes the docs as markdown pages. The cited docs, including the CLI and MCP pages, are served as agent-readable .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and no evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt or independent corroboration of agent use.
